title: Why the Bugatti Veyron Almost Never Happened
description:
Why did the Bugatti Veyron almost never happen? Here is the honest version, which starts with a correction. None of our sources says the Veyron was nearly cancelled. What they do say is a story of a failed revival, a chairman's pitch on a bullet train, an engine that was redesigned, parts that failed at speeds nobody had tested, delays of years, and, reportedly, a loss of millions of dollars on every car. That is the story, with every claim sourced. We read Wikipedia's pages on the Veyron, the Chiron, the EB one ten and Bugatti Automobiles, Motor One's twenty-year feature, Top Gear, Car magazine, and Jalopnik. When two sources give different dates or numbers, we show both. Where we do the arithmetic, we label it as ours. And where a claim is a quote, we say who said it.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
